updates.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Opus 5: Near-Fable Intelligence at Half the Cost
updates.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5 (`claude-opus-5`) on July 24, 2026 — a step-change improvement over Claude Opus 4.8 that approaches Claude Fable 5's frontier intelligence at roughly half the price ($5/$25 per million tokens). The model ships with a 1M-token context window, 128k max output tokens, thinking on by default, and a full effort ladder (low → max) so users can trade cost for capability per request. It's available immediately on the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry, and is now the default model on Claude Max and the strongest on Claude Pro. Accompanying API updates include mid-conversation tool changes in beta (add/remove tools without breaking the prompt cache), a new 'default' server-side fallback mode, and the removal of fast mode for Opus 4.7.
updates.accuracy_notes: Verified directly from official Anthropic platform release notes (platform.claude.com). Pricing, context window, and availability confirmed against multiple independent coverage sources (TechCrunch, Fortune, Axios, 9to5Mac — all reporting July 24, 2026). ARC-AGI-3 score of 30.16% at high effort verified by ARC Prize Foundation. Note: published July 24, technically 72h before July 27 (slightly outside strict 48h window), but is the most recent official Anthropic release and the dominant news story of the week.

updates.title: Claude Code v2.1.220 — Bug Fixes and Reliability Improvements (July 25, 2026)
updates.summary: Claude Code released version 2.1.220 on July 25, 2026, containing bug fixes and reliability improvements. This is a maintenance release following the major v2.1.219 update on July 24 (which added Claude Opus 5 as the default Opus model, nested subagent support up to depth 3, dynamic workflow size guidelines, and numerous bug fixes). The July 25 release is a minor stability patch with no new headline features.
